scientific_integrity: The uniform perfect-matching covariance projection, all Gram determinants, odd-unicyclic incidence-minor combinatorics, and sharp labeled determinant maxima are proved; finite computations corroborate but do not replace the all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: Uses complete-graph uniform perfect matchings and first-degree edge Walsh coordinate selection, not weighted or higher-degree sampling. Matching-incidence rank and TU minors are prior theory; equivalent historical design results remain a residual risk. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Exact Walsh sampling determinants and optimal coordinate bases on perfect matchings
